title: Fail before traffic flows on an incompatible or malformed plan
statement: The X-Verse platform must fail closed before any traffic flows when an identity, direction, schema, interaction, capability, policy, or plan-shape condition is incompatible or malformed.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007; T020 verifies the plan-shape/malformed leg only.
verification_intent: Realized for the T020 test slice by T020-SR-002.
acceptance_criteria: A malformed or closed-shape-violating plan is rejected with a stable code and no decoded value.
No rejected/failed call returns a partial or decoded value.
